name: set_object_animation_with_flag_0x10000

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetObjectAnimationWithFlag0x10000 consumes one animation ID, ORs it with 0x10000, and queues the same type-5 selected-object animation operation used by command 13

notes: This is the flagged counterpart to command 13 set_object_animation: the handlers are structurally identical except that ScriptCommand_SetObjectAnimationWithFlag0x10000 sets motion-request bit 0x10000 before the object-operation dispatcher passes the request to func_00130248. The downstream meaning of that motion-request bit remains unresolved, so the name records the proven encoding rather than speculating about playback behavior. The JP corpus contains 380 calls.
